verdict.rationale: Community users describe Meilisearch's batch indexing: a 7M-article bulk import, an 80M-document self-host where batch indexing fixed throughput, and 1,000,000 records sent in one go. First-party docs only mention adding documents, including via MCP prompts, and database auto-sync. One report says indexing of constantly changing records fell behind, but that limits throughput rather than contradicting the capability. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of bulk add/update/delete endpoints, bulk operations by filter across many items, and evidence of agent-driven bulk workflows.
